Subject: Q4 commit audit — red/yellow hand-offs and action owners

Team —

Quick audit ahead of tomorrow's commit review: Acme's renewal is in our Q4 numbers but multiple stage inconsistencies and one pricing contingency are creating risk flags. I attached a working grid (Q4_commit_audit.xlsx) with a proposed red/yellow/green categorization and suggested owners. Please do two things by EOD Monday:

1) Update the Stage in SFDC to match the grid (Stage and Close Date).
2) Confirm the owner column next to each red/yellow deal (reply inline).

Notes on prioritization (see tab "RiskGrid"):
- RED: Odds <= 30% or legal/pricing block (requires exec attention).
- YELLOW: Active negotiations, needs SOW or procurement checks; owner confirmation required.
- GREEN: Committed with signatures or active PoC with budget sign-off.

Acme is currently marked as Commit in the forecast but the procurement team still has open questions. Amy — I included you so you see our internal ask; we will not advance the forecast until the procurement items are resolved or we have an explicit commit date.

Attachments: Q4_commit_audit.xlsx (working), preliminary PDF export (20261114-deal-risk-grid.pdf)

Mina
